name: Power BI Modeling MCP
description: Brings Power BI semantic modeling to agents — read and edit TMDL definitions, create measures, and modify tabular models directly from an AI coding assistant.

skills.name: TMDL Editing
skills.description: Reads and writes Tabular Model Definition Language files so agents can modify a semantic model as structured code.

skills.name: Measure Authoring
skills.description: Creates and updates DAX measures, columns, and hierarchies inside a Power BI semantic model.

skills.name: Model Inspection
skills.description: Inspects tables, relationships, and existing measures in a connected model to ground agent edits in real structure.
